purpose: Five-year top-down sector/theme research overlay. This does not directly alter company quality scores or authorize buys.

context_inputs.role: Current macro regime and six-month risk-budget context

sources.title: Electricity 2026 - Executive summary
supported_claims: Global electricity demand is forecast to grow 3.6% per year on average during 2026-2030.
The projected growth rate is roughly 50% above the previous decade's average.

sources.title: Energy and AI
supported_claims: Global data-centre electricity consumption is projected to reach about 945 TWh by 2030 in the Base Case.
Accelerated-server electricity consumption is projected to grow about 30% per year through 2030.
In the United States, data centres account for nearly half of projected electricity-demand growth to 2030.
Renewables, natural gas, nuclear and grid/storage infrastructure all contribute to meeting incremental data-centre demand.

sources.title: Global Semiconductor Equipment Sales Forecast to Reach a Record $229 Billion in 2028
supported_claims: SEMI forecasts semiconductor manufacturing equipment sales of $165.9 billion in 2026 and $229.5 billion in 2028.
AI-driven leading-edge logic, advanced memory, test and packaging are cited as major growth drivers.

sources.title: SEMI Projects 300mm Memory Equipment Investment to Surpass $50 Billion in 2026
supported_claims: Worldwide 300mm memory equipment investment is projected at about $52 billion in 2026 and $57 billion in 2027.
Spending is projected to approach $80 billion by 2029, driven by HBM, DDR5 and data-storage demand.

sources.title: Defence investment and NATO's 5% commitment
supported_claims: Allies committed to invest 5% of GDP annually on defence by 2035.
At least 3.5% is for core defence requirements and up to 1.5% for defence- and security-related spending.
European Allies and Canada increased combined defence expenditure by nearly 20% in real terms in 2025 versus 2024.

sources.title: Increasing defence industrial production
supported_claims: NATO is explicitly expanding industrial production capacity, including air-defence and strike capabilities.

sources.title: Forecast Analysis: Information Security, Worldwide, 2026
supported_claims: Worldwide information-security spending is expected to reach $244 billion in 2026 with 11.6% constant-currency growth.

sources.title: Gartner Forecasts Worldwide AI Spending to Grow 47% in 2026
supported_claims: AI cybersecurity spending is forecast at about $51.3 billion in 2026 and $86.0 billion in 2027.
AI infrastructure is the largest spending category in the cited forecast.

sources.title: Gartner Forecasts the Market for Securing AI Will Reach $4.8 Billion in 2027
supported_claims: The market for securing AI is forecast at about $4.8 billion in 2027 and $7.7 billion in 2028.

sources.title: US Robot Industry Returns to Double Digit Growth
supported_claims: U.S. industrial robot installations rose 11% to about 38,000 units in 2025.
Food-industry installations rose about 30%.

classification_note: Sector rankings, time-phase leadership and relative attractiveness scores are analyst opinions/inferences. Forecasts from IEA, SEMI and Gartner remain forecasts, not realized facts.
